export class FundingCalculator{/**
   * 计算资金费率反向策略
   * @param params 策略参数
   * @param currentPrice 当前价格（可选）
   * @param currentFundingRate 当前资金费率（可选）
   * @returns 计算结果
   */static calculate(params,currentPrice,currentFundingRate){const{fundingThreshold,leverageRatio,maxLevels,totalCapital,isLong}=params;// 验证参数

const basePrice=currentPrice||50000;// 计算每档投入金额（平均分配）
const amountPerLevel=totalCapital/maxLevels;const levels=[];let totalInvested=0;let totalHoldings=0;// 检查资金费率条件
let fundingConditionMet=false;if(currentFundingRate!==undefined){if(isLong){// 做多：当资金费率为负时（空头支付多头）
fundingConditionMet=currentFundingRate<fundingThreshold;}else{// 做空：当资金费率为正时（多头支付空头）
fundingConditionMet=currentFundingRate>fundingThreshold;}}// 计算每个档位
for(let i=1;i<=maxLevels;i++){// 根据做多做空方向计算触发价格
let triggerPrice;if(isLong){// 做多：价格下跌时加仓
const priceStep=5;// 每档5%跌幅
triggerPrice=basePrice*(1-i*priceStep/100);}else{// 做空：价格上涨时加仓
const priceStep=5;// 每档5%涨幅
triggerPrice=basePrice*(1+i*priceStep/100);}const investAmount=amountPerLevel;// 考虑杠杆的实际持仓量
const leveragedAmount=investAmount*leverageRatio;const holdings=leveragedAmount/triggerPrice;// 判断是否已触发
let triggered=false;if(currentPrice&&currentFundingRate!==undefined){const priceCondition=isLong?currentPrice<=triggerPrice:currentPrice>=triggerPrice;// 第一档需要同时满足资金费率和价格条件
if(i===1){triggered=fundingConditionMet&&priceCondition;}else{// 后续档位：需要第一档已触发且价格条件满足
const firstLevelTriggered=levels.length>0&&levels[0].triggered;triggered=firstLevelTriggered&&priceCondition;}}if(triggered){totalInvested+=investAmount;totalHoldings+=holdings;}const level={level:i,triggerPrice,investAmount,holdings,cumulativeInvested:triggered?totalInvested:0,cumulativeHoldings:triggered?totalHoldings:0,averageCost:triggered&&totalHoldings>0?totalInvested/totalHoldings:0,triggered,// 添加杠杆相关信息
leverageRatio,leveragedAmount};levels.push(level);}// 计算平均成本
const averagePrice=totalHoldings>0?totalInvested/totalHoldings:0;const remainingCash=totalCapital-totalInvested;// 计算未实现盈亏（考虑杠杆）
let unrealizedPnL=0;let maxDrawdown=0;let fundingPnL=0;if(currentPrice&&totalHoldings>0){// 计算价格变动盈亏
const currentValue=totalHoldings*currentPrice;const costValue=totalHoldings*averagePrice;if(isLong){unrealizedPnL=currentValue-costValue;}else{unrealizedPnL=costValue-currentValue;// 做空时价格下跌为盈利
}// 计算资金费率收益（简化计算）
if(currentFundingRate!==undefined){const leveragedPosition=totalInvested*leverageRatio;fundingPnL=leveragedPosition*Math.abs(currentFundingRate)*0.1;// 假设持有0.1天
}// 总盈亏 = 价格盈亏 + 资金费率收益
unrealizedPnL+=fundingPnL;// 计算最大回撤
if(totalInvested>0){maxDrawdown=Math.min(0,unrealizedPnL/totalInvested);}}const result={id:"calc_".concat(Date.now(),"_").concat(Math.random().toString(36).substr(2,9)),strategyId:params.id,strategyName:params.name,strategyType:params.type,calculatedAt:new Date(),levels,totalInvested,averagePrice,totalHoldings,remainingCapital:remainingCash,currentPriceAnalysis:currentPrice&&totalHoldings>0?{currentPrice,unrealizedPnL,unrealizedPnLPercentage:totalInvested>0?unrealizedPnL/totalInvested:0}:undefined,maxDrawdown,// 添加资金费率相关信息
currentFundingRate,fundingPnL,leverageRatio};return result;}/**
   * 获取资金费率策略状态
   * @param params 策略参数
   * @param currentFundingRate 当前资金费率
   * @returns 策略状态信息

status='extreme';message='资金费率极端，注意风险控制';}else if(conditionMet){status='ready';message=isLong?'负费率，适合做多收取费用':'正费率，适合做空收取费用';}else{status='waiting';message="\u7B49\u5F85".concat(isLong?'负':'正',"\u8D39\u7387\u4FE1\u53F7");}return{status,message,conditionMet,distance,fundingLevel:this.getFundingLevel(currentFundingRate),direction:isLong?'做多':'做空'};}/**
   * 获取资金费率水平描述
   * @param rate 资金费率
   * @returns 费率水平描述
   */static getFundingLevel(rate){const absRate=Math.abs(rate);if(absRate>=0.01)return'极端';if(absRate>=0.005)return'很高';if(absRate>=0.002)return'较高';if(absRate>=0.001)return'正常';return'很低';}/**

const annualizedReturn=totalFundingReturn/totalCapital*(365/days);return{dailyReturn:fundingPerSettlement*settlementsPerDay,totalReturn:totalFundingReturn,returnRate:totalFundingReturn/totalCapital,annualizedReturn};}/**
   * 生成策略建议
   * @param params 策略参数
   * @param currentFundingRate 当前资金费率
   * @returns 建议列表
   */static generateRecommendations(params,currentFundingRate){const recommendations=[];const{leverageRatio,isLong,fundingThreshold}=params;const status=this.getStrategyStatus(params,currentFundingRate);// 资金费率状态建议
if(status.status==='extreme'){recommendations.push('⚠️ 资金费率极端，虽然收益高但风险也大');recommendations.push('💡 建议降低杠杆倍数或减少仓位');}else if(status.status==='ready'){recommendations.push('✅ 资金费率条件满足，可以开始执行策略');recommendations.push("\uD83D\uDCCB \u5F53\u524D".concat(status.direction,"\u65B9\u5411\u6709\u5229\uFF0C\u6CE8\u610F\u4EF7\u683C\u53D8\u52A8\u98CE\u9669"));}else{recommendations.push("\uD83D\uDCCA \u7B49\u5F85".concat(isLong?'负':'正',"\u8D39\u7387\u4FE1\u53F7\uFF0C\u5F53\u524D\u8D39\u7387").concat((currentFundingRate*100).toFixed(3),"%"));}// 杠杆建议
if(leverageRatio>10){recommendations.push('⚠️ 杠杆倍数较高，注意爆仓风险');recommendations.push('💰 建议设置止损，控制最大损失');}else if(leverageRatio<3){recommendations.push('📈 杠杆倍数较低，资金费率收益有限');}// 阈值建议
const absThreshold=Math.abs(fundingThreshold);if(absThreshold<0.001){recommendations.push('🎯 费率阈值较低，触发频率可能较高');}else if(absThreshold>0.005){recommendations.push('⏰ 费率阈值较高，需要等待极端市场情况');}// 通用建议
recommendations.push('📊 密切关注资金费率变化，及时调整策略');recommendations.push('⚖️ 平衡资金费率收益与价格变动风险');return recommendations;}/**
   * 验证策略参数
   * @param params 策略参数
   * @returns 验证结果
   */static validateParams(params){const errors=[];if(params.fundingThreshold===undefined||Math.abs(params.fundingThreshold)>1){errors.push('资金费率阈值必须在-1到1之间');}if(!params.leverageRatio||params.leverageRatio<=0||params.leverageRatio>100){errors.push('杠杆倍数必须在0-100之间');}if(!params.maxLevels||params.maxLevels<=0||params.maxLevels>20){errors.push('最大档数必须在1-20之间');}if(!params.totalCapital||params.totalCapital<=0){errors.push('总本金必须大于0');}if(params.isLong===undefined){errors.push('必须选择做多或做空方向');}// 风险检查
